name: core.openwop.workflows.kicktodo-loops
description: KickTodo enrollment + scheduled loops (enrollment, daily-loop, reminder-loop), migrated from the deprecated builtins (ADR 0472 P4). chainIds keep the original ids so scheduler-continuation ignition + replay resolve unchanged. Enrollment demonstrates RFC 0133 produced variables: `enroll` writes `enrollmentId` to the bag, `materialize` reads it.
